messages:
jaya: FYI planning a tiny base-image cutover Thur AM to move to distroless, drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN, tighten seccomp, and add cosign signing. Need RBAC & KMS sign path sanity check.

maria: Any UID/GID changes? Will PVs break?

jaya: No user changes but distroless strips a few binaries. We have smoke tests. PVs might need chown on startup.

samir: RBAC: do NOT grant broad kms roles. Use roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier scoped to cryptoKey with condition restricting callers to serviceAccount:ci-rebuild@redwood-prod and group:image-signers. Also export KMS audit logs to sec-logs and alert on out-of-window signs.

sec-oncall: Suggested binding snippet:
```
- role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
  members:
    - serviceAccount:ci-rebuild@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    - group:image-signers@redwood.com
  condition:
    title: "distroless-cutover-window"
    expression: "resource.name.endsWith('/cryptoKeys/rebuild-minor-2026') && request.time < timestamp('2026-04-10T00:00:00Z')"
```

toni: CI cosign command in pipeline: COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/rebuild-minor-2026 $IMAGE. Admission webhook will verify.

maria: Add SBOM diff and cosign verify step; test `ctr run` smoke. Add init chown for PVCs.

samir: Also add a runbook: quick revert, how to disable webhook, and how to revoke KMS binding if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy: staging canary scheduled 2026-04-08T09:00Z awaiting approvals (required=2)

jaya: I'll open IAM PR + alerting PR now and link them. Tagging @sec-oncall for final review. If canary fails, abort and revert tag.
